title: Similarity hint in ticket create without a fixed threshold
description: ticket create names tickets close in meaning when the optional model is installed. A candidate counts when it stands 3.5 robust deviations (median, MAD) above the median of all other tickets. No hint by meaning below 10 other tickets, when the model is missing or with PLANTOOL_SIMILAR=off; the title-word hint always works. The plain z-score of plantool similar was tried first and rejected: groups of related tickets hide each other.
why: The fixed 0.86 threshold gave a false positive at 0.864 in calibration and contradicts the z-score rule of plantool similar.

acceptance.text: ticket create and plantool similar use the same rule (OVERLAP_Z)
No hint by meaning when the project has too few tickets for a distribution
Keyword hint still works without a model

skipped.data: Reads ticket titles and descriptions only; nothing new is stored.
skipped.contracts: Internal function, no contract other code plans against.

outcome.summary: Fixed threshold removed. Robust strength instead of the plain z-score, because groups of related tickets hid each other (z 3.6 with one related ticket, 2.3 with four). The first acceptance point changed with it: the hint and plantool similar do not share one rule yet; see PLAN-7.
outcome.verifiedBy: node --test: 73 pass, 1 skipped; real model test passed on Linux
